Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for construction (widening/four laning etc.,), Maintenance, management 
and operation of National Highway 167AG on the stretch of land from Km 0.000 to Km 37.900 (Kondamodu - 
Perecherla Road) in the district of Palnadu in the state of ANDHRA PRADESH 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Andhra Prabha(Telugu)” and 
“The Hindu (English)” both dated 16-10-2022; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 

And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 

Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 

And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 29th September, 2023 


9.0. 4272(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, S.O. No. 2860(E) Dated: 30/06/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, 
Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation 
of Proposed Bangalore-Chennai Expressway NHNE-7 in the stretch of land design Chainnage Km. 0/000 to 
Km. 11/450 in the district of Bangalore Rural in the state of KARNATAKA . 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Samyuktha Karnataka” in Kananda 
Language and “Times of India” in English Language both dated 18/07/2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of 
the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

New Delhi, the 29th September, 2023 


S.O. 4279(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 1638(E) Dated:05/04/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (winding/two laning etc.,) Maintenance, management and operation 
of NH516E in the stretch of land from Km. 248.916 to Km. 262.26 (Design chainage 0.000 to 13.000 )(Paderu Bypass 
Section) in the district of Alluri Sitharama Raju in the state of ANDHRA PRADESH. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Andhra Prabha” and “The Hindu” 
both dated 08.04.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


[भाग 1---खण्ड 3(ii)] भारत का राजपत्र : असाधारण 29 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 


vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

का.आ. 4266(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उप-धारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह समाधान 
हो जाने के पश्चात्‌ कि पंजाब राज्य के गुरदासपुर जिले में NH54 के कि.मी. 22.65 से कि.मी.60.27 तक के भू-खण्ड के 
निर्माण (चौड़ीकरण/पेग्ड शोल्‌डर सहित 2-लेन/4-लेन का बनाना आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबन्धन और प्रचालन के लोक प्रयोजन 
के लिए वह भूमि अपेक्षित है जिसका संक्षिप्त वर्णन नीचे अनुसूची में दिया गया है, ऐसी भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने 
आशय की घोषणा करती है। 


कोई भी व्यक्ति, जो उक्त भूमि में हितबद्ध है, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3ग की उप-धारा (1) के अधीन पूर्वोक्त 
प्रयोजन के लिए ऐसी भूमि के उपयोग पर राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से इक्नकीस दिन के भीतर अपनी 
आपत्ति प्रकट कर सकेगा | 


ऐसी प्रत्येक आपत्ति सक्षम प्राधिकारी, अर्थात्‌ सब डिविजनल मजिस्ट्रेट गुरदासपुर को लिखित रूप मे प्रस्तुत की

S.O. 4268(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section () of section 3A of the National Highways

acquire such land.

Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(l) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Deputy Collector (Revenue) in 
writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of 
being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making 
such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the 
objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.
